organs.Notes: Results p. 9 and SI Fig. S27 reference. Authors report no significant morphological change in heart, liver, spleen, lung, kidney or intestines at either RuZ dose compared with vehicle in the MDA-MB-231/Adr xenograft study. The main text does not give a separate histology sample size. SI Fig. S27 (p. 26) confirms all six H&E panels for both RuZ doses and the day-14 collection. The Dox panel is labeled 5.0 mg/kg, whereas the efficacy protocol on SI p. 10 lists 3.0 mg/kg. The Dox dose and outcome are unassigned for this histology comparison.
